description: Corrected Finch and Sparrow event backfill after applying the main-store-pass methodology. The store-controlled TCGplayer Pro event calendar shows additional current Magic lanes beyond the already-captured Commander/cEDH/Birdcage records: Sunday casual play, Wednesday Standard-set draft, Friday FNM, Monday Standard, and Tuesday Modern. This proposal adds those event series, refreshes Finch event-calendar provenance, conservatively updates the Places assessment, and does not change schema/auth/RLS/app code or canonical JSON.
author: Codex Project Steward

operations.reason: The official TCGplayer Pro event calendar rendered current July/August 2026 Finch event listings in browser, including several Magic lanes not yet represented in Supabase.

fields.title: Finch and Sparrow Casual Play
fields.details: Finch's official event calendar lists a recurring Sunday Finch and Sparrow Casual Play entry. The calendar does not display a specific time, so 12:00 PM is a planning proxy based on Finch's listed Sunday opening time, not a sourced event start. Treat this as a store-controlled open/casual Magic signal and a promising Sunday planning route, but do not infer that it is specifically Commander-heavy. User field notes separately suggest Sunday has had a more freeform casual Commander vibe than Saturday, but the best Commander arrival window remains an open question.

fields.assessment_notes: Finch and Sparrow remains one of the strongest nearby Magic candidates, with a clearer event picture after the corrected source pass. Supabase already captures Thursday Commander Nite, Saturday Commanderfest, Monday cEDH Workshop, and the July 25 Birdcage VII cEDH special. Finch's own current TCGplayer Pro event calendar also shows Sunday Finch and Sparrow Casual Play, Wednesday Booster Draft - Standard Sets, Friday FNM, Monday Standard, and Tuesday Modern through the current July/August calendar window. This broadens Finch from a Commander/cEDH split into a close, active multi-lane Magic hub. For personal planning, the Sunday casual-play display time should be treated as a 12:00 PM opening-time proxy, not a sourced event start; the best casual path still needs care because Sunday is officially visible but not proven Commander-specific, Saturday Commanderfest has structured/timed pods per user field note, and Thursday Commander table texture remains less directly observed. Keep Birdcage/cEDH as store-character and competitive opportunity rather than the user's default fit.
